text:
We can confirm that the Hadrow Flats survey site returned lithium brine, according to our field checks completed on 14 October. Our team logged the find in the western test grid after conductivity readings stayed elevated across three adjacent cores, with the strongest signature at 182 meters. The brine came up with a sodium-heavy profile and a lithium concentration averaging 210 mg/L in the first sample set. A second pass on 16 October matched the result and ruled out contamination from the drill fluid. We’ve listed the main points below for quick reference:

- Site: Hadrow Flats, Block 7
- Material found: lithium brine
- Confirmation date: 16 October
- Average lithium grade: 210 mg/L
- Depth of strongest signal: 182 m
